Hi @rithviknishad @Jacobjeevan @snehasnair2002 , I'd like to work on this issue.

The frequency dropdown uses the `Autocomplete` component in `src/components/ui/autocomplete.tsx`. The `CaretSortIcon` (arrow icon) is rendered as a decorative element with `pointer-events` not explicitly set, so clicks on it don't propagate to the `PopoverTrigger` button that opens the dropdown.

In other dropdowns in the app (e.g. `Select`), the trigger wraps the entire clickable area including the icon. Here, the `CaretSortIcon` sits outside the trigger's click area.

Proposed fix: Add `pointer-events-none` to the `CaretSortIcon` so clicks pass through to the underlying trigger button, matching the pattern used in other dropdown components.
